detailZones.title: Dialysis chair and monitor
detailZones.description: Inspect the unoccupied dialysis chair, bedside monitor, blood-pressure cuff, table and visible chair hardware.

detailZones.title: Dialysis delivery console
detailZones.description: Explore the blank console screen, control panel, pump modules, doors, lower cabinet and mobile base.

detailZones.title: Dialyzer and bloodline circuit
detailZones.description: Follow the clear dialyzer housing, caps, bloodline tubes, drip chambers, clamps, connectors and supports.

detailZones.title: Dialysis wall box and connections
detailZones.description: Inspect the recessed dialysis wall box, treated-water, concentrate, drain and electrical connections.

detailZones.title: Utility cart and disinfection area
detailZones.description: Explore the closed-drawer supply cart, waste containers, sink, counter, cabinet and visible cleaning supplies.

detailZones.title: Room support and background stations
detailZones.description: Follow the glass partition, background dialysis stations, privacy curtains, ceiling services, door hardware and floor.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source and resized hemodialysis photographs were inspected at native and final pixels. This batch retains 150 independently pointable dialysis-chair, console, dialyzer, bloodline, wall-box, utility, cleaning and room-support parts across 6 bounded zones. Patient identity, diagnoses, medication names, doses, readings, alarm states, treatment steps, blood or fluid claims, hidden functions, brands, readable screen content and signage were excluded.
